text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Haaah... nggh, dammit.
Those guys just had to hold on till the bitter end...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She looks awfully sleepy.
She was supposed to have taken yesterday off, though.
When I ask her what happened――

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah... is it because... it's the publisher's official booth...?
...Every single one of them is an expert seller...
......Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
…………
...Those kids... honestly...
What a troublesome... hobby...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Nakayama Festa mumbled sleepily. Apparently she took part in an auction and barely got any rest...
